name: CloddsBot
description: Open Source AI trading agent that operates autonomously across 1000+ markets - Polymarket, Kalshi, Binance, Hyperliquid, Solana DEXs, 5 EVM chains. Scans for edge, executes instantly, manages risk while you sleep. Agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments. Self-hosted. Built on Claude.
one_liner: A bot that trades prediction markets and crypto automatically for you, chatting with you over apps like Telegram or Discord about what it's doing.
buyer: An active crypto/prediction-market trader who wants automated 24/7 trading but doesn't want to write their own bot — though this is a genuinely risky category to build a business on.
business_use_cases: A crypto trading community offers paid access to a shared, configured instance as a member perk for a Discord/Telegram trading group.
A freelance dev offers paid setup-and-tuning services to traders who want it running but can't configure it themselves.
A content creator in the crypto space uses it to generate 'the bot made this trade, here's why' content to drive audience engagement.

money_ideas.idea: Charge for managed setup and strategy tuning, since self-hosting and risk configuration is the main friction point.
Sell access to a curated set of trading strategies/configs as a subscription.

steal_this: Be honest: this is a financial/regulatory minefield (unlicensed trading advice, custody of funds, a project-associated memecoin listed in its own README). The safer weekend project is a paid 'setup and monitoring' service, not running money through it yourself.
